Description:
std::uint16_t optinal member timestamp_interval which represents the IEEE1722 defined
timestamp_interval 16 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype CRF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00 00 ... 0xFF FF : valid
For transmission, the middleware shall set the value of timestamp_interval to the configured
value, if it is not be provided by the application.
